items.informal_name: Uniqueness of Polynomial Functions via Witt Polynomial Substitution
items.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) {idx : Type u_1} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (f g : ℕ → MvPolynomial (idx × ℕ) ℤ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) (wittPolynomial p ℤ n) = (MvPolynomial.bind₁ g) (wittPolynomial p ℤ n)) → f = g
items.informal_description: For a prime $ p $, if two functions $ f, g : \mathbb{N} \to \mathrm{MvPolynomial}(\mathrm{idx} \times \mathbb{N}, \mathbb{Z}) $ satisfy $ \mathrm{bind}_1(f)(W_n(p)) = \mathrm{bind}_1(g)(W_n(p)) $ for all $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, where $ W_n(p) $ denotes the $ n $-th Witt polynomial, then $ f = g $. Here, $ \mathrm{bind}_1 $ represents the variable substitution homomorphism replacing variables in the polynomial with the function's values.

items.informal_name: Approximation of Polynomials over Finite Fields via Modulo Operations
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] {b : Polynomial Fq},
  b ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ (A : Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-Real.log ε / Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊).succ → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any non-zero polynomial $ b $ over a finite field $ \mathbb{F}_q $ and any $ \varepsilon > 0 $, if $ A $ is a family of polynomials indexed by a finite set of size $ q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log q \rceil} $, then there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 $ such that the $ \mathbb{F}_q $-cardinality-degree norm of $ (A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) $ is less than $ \varepsilon \cdot q^{\deg b} $. Here, the cardinality-degree norm $ \text{cardPowDegree}(p) $ of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as $ q^{\deg p} $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Polynomial Partition with Degree Condition
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ ↔ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and function $A : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a function $t : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathrm{Fin}(\#\mathbb{F}_q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log \#\mathbb{F}_q \rceil})$ such that for all $i_0, i_1 \in \mathrm{Fin}(n)$, $t(i_0) = t(i_1)$ if and only if $\deg(A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) < \deg(b) \cdot \varepsilon$.

items.informal_name: Ideal Generated by Polynomial Set is Unchanged under Monic Division Remainder Replacement
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {i j : ι},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (v : ι → Polynomial R),
      (v i).Monic → Ideal.span (Set.range (Function.update v j (v j %ₘ v i))) = Ideal.span (Set.range v)
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative ring, $ \iota $ an index type, and $ v : \iota \to R[X] $ a function assigning polynomials to indices. Suppose $ i \neq j $ and $ v_i $ is monic. Replacing $ v_j $ with its remainder modulo $ v_i $ (i.e., $ v_j \mod v_i $) does not change the ideal generated by the image of $ v $. Formally, the ideal spanned by $ \{v_k \mid k \in \iota\} $ equals the ideal spanned by $ \{v_k\}_{k \neq j} \cup \{v_j \mod v_i\} $.

items.informal_name: Partitioning Polynomials with Bounded Differences Modulo a Non-Zero Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ → ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real number $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and sequence of $n$ polynomials $A_0, \ldots, A_{n-1} \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a partition function $t$ mapping indices $\{0, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $\left\lceil \frac{-\log \varepsilon}{\log |\mathbb{F}_q|} \right\rceil$ classes such that for any two indices $i_0, i_1$ in the same class, the difference $A_{i_1} \mod b - A_{i_0} \mod b$ has $\text{cardPowDegree}$ strictly less than $\varepsilon \cdot \text{cardPowDegree}(b)$. Here, $\text{cardPowDegree}$ denotes a degree-like measure combining field cardinality and polynomial degree, and $|\mathbb{F}_q|$ is the size of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.

items.informal_name: Remainder Equality for Monic Polynomial Division under Divisibility of the Difference
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q ∣ p₁ - p₂ → p₁ %ₘ q = p₂ %ₘ q
items.informal_description: If $ q $ is a monic polynomial and $ q $ divides $ p_1 - p_2 $, then the remainder of $ p_1 $ divided by $ q $ is equal to the remainder of $ p_2 $ divided by $ q $.
